limitations: One-output unit-hidden-weight degree-two networks with l1 output regularization. The block-nuclear certificate is a lower bound and is not exact in general dimension; scalar/aligned and orthogonal rank-one exact formulas require enough width to realize the stated atom constructions. No statistical or finite-precision claim is made.
provenance: Source-specific convex analysis of the regularized quadratic-neural-network lift in arXiv:2609.17654, using the exact neural-spectrahedron aggregate representation to derive a stronger block-nuclear lower bound and exact induced regularizers on scalar and rank-one families.
record_title: Block-nuclear lower bounds and exact low-rank regularizers for quadratic neural networks
